name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-jobs-mcp
title: Iran Jobs (IranTalent + Jobinja + Jobvision)
description: Read-only Iran jobs: IranTalent, Jobinja, Jobvision side by side. Ads, companies, reviews, pay.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_JOBS_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the IranTalent, Jobinja and Jobvision requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
